what_it_is.prose: Maini Precision Products Limited (MPPL) is a Bengaluru-based precision-engineering company, incorporated in 1973 and promoted by the Maini family, that manufactures high-tolerance machined components and assemblies. It operates two broad business lines: an Aerospace & Defence segment (started in 2004) making precision products for aerospace and defence applications, and an Automotive & Industrial segment covering clean-powertrain components, hydraulics and agricultural products. The company is strongly export-oriented — exports accounted for roughly 65-72% of revenue per its 2022 draft red-herring prospectus — positioning it as a Tier-1/Tier-2 supplier into global aerospace and industrial supply chains, with machining tolerances quoted down to 3 microns and processes spanning machined and die castings, forgings, and surface/heat treatment. Financials disclosed in the 2022 SEBI filing showed revenue of ₹560.3 crore in FY19, ₹570 crore in FY20 and ₹427.36 crore in FY21 (the last COVID-affected). MPPL received SEBI approval in 2022 for a roughly ₹900 crore IPO (a ₹150 crore fresh issue plus an offer for sale of about ₹750 crore), though that IPO was not subsequently completed. Its India military-aerospace relevance is as a private-sector precision-manufacturing supplier feeding aerospace and defence programmes; this entry is tiered B because publicly retrievable primary evidence linking MPPL to specific named Indian military-aircraft programmes is limited, and the most detailed public financials date to the 2022 prospectus.

deployments_procurement.summary: Maini Precision is a component and assembly supplier rather than a platform or systems contractor; it does not hold publicly documented prime contracts with the Indian armed forces. Its aerospace & defence work (since 2004) is as an export-oriented precision manufacturer supplying components and assemblies into global aerospace and defence supply chains, complementing its automotive and industrial business.

import_dependencies.summary: As a build-to-print/build-to-spec precision manufacturer, Maini works to designs and specifications set by aerospace and defence OEMs; the intellectual property, raw-material grades and qualification standards originate with foreign customers, while the manufacturing value-add is performed in India. Special alloys, aerospace-grade raw materials and certain machine tools are import-linked.

faq.question: What does Maini Precision Products make?
faq.answer: Maini Precision Products is a Bengaluru precision-engineering company (incorporated 1973) that makes high-tolerance machined components and assemblies. It runs an Aerospace & Defence segment (started in 2004) supplying precision parts for aerospace/defence applications, and an Automotive & Industrial segment covering clean-powertrain components, hydraulics and agriculture. It is export-heavy (about 65-72% of revenue from exports per its 2022 prospectus) with machining tolerances down to 3 microns.

faq.question: Is Maini Precision a listed company and how big is it?
faq.answer: Maini remains privately held. It received SEBI approval in 2022 for a roughly ₹900 crore IPO (a ₹150 crore fresh issue plus about ₹750 crore offer for sale), but that IPO was not subsequently completed. The most detailed public financials, from the 2022 draft prospectus, showed revenue of ₹560.3 crore (FY19), ₹570 crore (FY20) and ₹427.36 crore (FY21, COVID-affected). Current figures are not publicly confirmed.
